title: Yellow Smoky Middle Eastern Burrata Warak Enab
description: A smoky and crumbly Middle Eastern dish featuring burrata cheese, served in a warak enab form with a rich mother sauce base, paleo friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the grape leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
In a blender, combine olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the mother sauce.
Arrange the grape leaves in a warak enab form, brushing each leaf with the mother sauce.
Place the burrata cheese in the center of the grape leaves, folding the leaves over to seal.
Bake the warak enab in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the leaves are crispy.
Serve the Yellow Smoky Middle Eastern Burrata Warak Enab hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of paleo friendly crackers or bread.
